'''2007 Illinois State Championship Andrew Shuman LS Local Uprising (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Andrew Shuman]] at [[2007 Illinois State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Local Uprising (V) / Liberation (V) (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth)|OVS4-11-Local_Uprising-remaster.webp|label=Local Uprising (V) / Liberation (V)}}
* '''Deck name:''' My little pony
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
